Learn More Samay wouldn’t be what it is today without the help of the NSF I-Corps. As a first-time founder without business experience, learning the ins and outs of customer discovery positioned us to get into the most competitive national programs and secure almost $2M in grant awards from NSF and NIH. Whenever I meet an early-stage founder, especially those who are not well represented in the tech industry (women and POC), I always tell them to complete this course before spending any time fundraising or building a product. Maria Artunduaga Founder, Samay Medical Doctorate (MD) Pontificia Universidad Javeriana Master of
